name: uigma
description: A Figma-like design editor and FigJam-like boards on the Hyper canvas, built on OpenPencil (MIT).

procs.label: Uigma
procs.description: Design files and boards in a full Figma-like editor on the canvas (OpenPencil): frames, auto layout, components with variants, variables, vectors, stickies, connectors and sections; .fig files in and out; the agent edits the same open file with uigma.run while the person watches.
